query: Which material can be used for improve the magnetocaloric properties, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Partial substitution of Ni by Co in Ni2MnSn-based Heusler alloys enhances their magnetocaloric effect near room temperature.
generation.material_initial_state: Undoped Ni2MnSn-based Heusler alloy samples in a polycrystalline ingot form.
generation.intervention: Introduce controlled amounts (up to ~10%) of Co to partially replace Ni in Ni2MnSn-based alloys.
generation.conditions: Samples are synthesized via conventional arc melting followed by annealing near 900°C and quenching; magnetization and calorimetric measurements are performed near room temperature under varying magnetic fields.
generation.structural_mediator: Co substitution modifies the Ni–Mn–Sn lattice, altering the phase transition regime and magnetic ordering.
generation.mechanism: Co doping impacts the electronic structure and exchange interactions, shifting the magnetic and structural transition temperatures and thus enhancing the magnetocaloric effect.
generation.predicted_outcome: An increase in magnetocaloric performance, potentially 10–20% higher than the undoped alloy in the same temperature range.
generation.baseline: Unmodified Ni2MnSn-based Heusler alloy displaying typical magnetocaloric properties for this family of materials.
generation.boundary: Excessive Co content (above ~10%) may destabilize the crystal structure, causing phase separation and reducing the net magnetocaloric effect.
generation.uncertainty: There is insufficient direct experimental data to confirm the exact impact on Curie temperature shifts and total entropy change.

falsification_experiment.design: Prepare a series of Co-doped Ni2MnSn-based alloys (0–10% Co) by arc melting, anneal them, and measure structural properties (via X-ray diffraction), thermal properties (DSC), and magnetization curves to compute the magnetocaloric response.
measurements: Phase identification and lattice constants from X-ray diffraction
Martensitic and/or magnetic transition temperatures from DSC, magnetometry
Isothermal magnetization curves to determine magnetic entropy change
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If Co doping does not shift magnetic/structural transition temperatures or does not improve the measured magnetocaloric effect relative to the undoped Ni2MnSn alloy, the hypothesis is falsified.
